SELECT dong_nm FROM APT_UNIT WHERE apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER( REGEXP_REPLACE(dong_nm, '[^0-9]') )

SELECT AD.HO_NO, AD.FLOOR, AD.HO_TY_NO, AD.HO_STTS_CD, AD.HO FROM APT_DETAIL AD JOIN APT_UNIT D ON AD.DONG_NO = D.DONG_NO WHERE D.APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo} AND D.DONG_NM = #{dongNm} ORDER BY FLOOR DESC, TO_NUMBER(AD.HO)
